scope: Worker-specific credential resolver and database factory unit checks
checks: worker credentials are read only from the named worker-specific environment key
generic and other-worker variables do not satisfy a missing credential
credential values below 32 or above 4096 UTF-8 bytes fail closed
exact 32-byte and 4096-byte values are accepted, counting UTF-8 bytes
opaque credential text is returned without normalization
invalid UTF-8 text and worker keys fail before secret use
worker DSN, login, transaction mode, and connection cleanup remain validated
